span.p:
the agent's fux-enrich skill writes
.fux/enrich/<sha>.md — 5–10 questions (doc2query)
fux never calls a model (L3)

div.style: color: rgb(58, 20, 20) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
fux enrich --check
a model question must retrieve its own document
in top 3 with title and ctx zeroed — else refused

div.style: color: rgb(18, 48, 28) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
fux correct "question" <doc>
a HUMAN line in the same file, corrections: N
logged to eval/corrections.tsv; --check reports, never refuses

--pin: one doc to #1 for one exact question
(deliberately brittle escape hatch)

weight 1.0, already in BM25F
